author: NIN Creative Studio

author: Chilling Tales for Dark Nights
title: Horror Illustrators Wanted - Paid Opportunities
content: HORROR ILLUSTRATORS WANTED — PAID OPPORTUNITIES. Chilling Tales for Dark Nights is looking for a handful of talented horror illustrators to create original artwork for us throughout the remainder of 2026 and into 2027. These are paid gigs. We’re seeking human-created artwork only. Interested? Email Craig Groshek with your portfolio, rates, and availability: craiggroshek [at] chillingtalesfordarknights.com Subject line: CTFDN ARTIST INTEREST

author: Puffball Comics
title: Artist Call for Abida Comic Line Art Finishing
content: 📢📢 ARTIST CALL FOR ABIDA📢📢 Puffball Comics is officially on a hunt for an exceptional Line Art Finishing Artist to join the production team for @theabidacomic Issue #2. We're looking for someone who can smoothly step into an established visual world and help us complete pages while maintaining the style, character, and energy of the graphic novel. What you'll be working on: Finishing and refining line art / inks, Supporting the completion of illustrated pages, Adding shadows, lighting, and finishing touches. Send us your portfolio at contact@puffball.pk

author: SALTO Participation & Information
title: Call for Illustrators - Democracy Stickers €1500
content: 🎨 Calling all artists and illustrators: Help bring participation and democracy to life! SALTO Participation & Information is looking for an illustrator to create a collection of approximately 10–15 original illustrations inspired by participation, democracy, etc. The illustrations will primarily become a series of fun and engaging stickers. Fee: €1,500 for the full assignment. Application deadline: 8 November 2026. Final illustrations completed by 18 December 2026. Generative AI illustrations will not be accepted. Find the full call and application details on our website or link in bio.
